headline: Musk pledges to give every US child one SpaceX share next year
summary: Elon Musk says he will give one of his SpaceX shares to every child in the US starting next year, a pledge estimated at more than $10 billion based on roughly 72 million US children. President Trump announced the shares will be distributed through Trump Accounts.

claims.statement: Elon Musk plans to give one SpaceX share to every child in the US, starting next year.

sources.quote: Musk pledges to give ‘every kid in America’ one of his SpaceX shares
Elon Musk says he plans to give one of his SpaceX shares to every child in the US starting next year.
Musk said earlier today that he would give one of his SpaceX shares to "every kid in America" sometime next year.

claims.statement: The pledge is valued at roughly $10-10.5 billion, or around 1% of Musk's net worth.

sources.quote: That's more than $10 billion in shares, or around 1% of Musk's current net worth.
Musk would be giving away about $10.5 billion worth of shares, according to a report from CNBC.

claims.statement: President Trump announced the shares for children will be distributed through Trump Accounts.

sources.quote: President Donald Trump announced this afternoon that Elon Musk's SpaceX shares for children will be given through Trump Accounts.
